Evidence: Pakistan ne chicken dishes par ban lagaya hai Aiwan-e-Sadar aur important state functions ke menu mein, jo health precaution ke liye hai. Health Minister Naseer Khan ne kaha ki yeh bird flu outbreak ke khilaf hai. Pakistan mein H5N1 strain ka outbreak confirm hua hai, lekin koi human case report nahi hua hai (Source 1).
Justification: Retrieved evidence se yeh pata chalta hai ki Pakistan ne chicken dishes par ban lagaya hai, jo health precaution ke liye hai, aur isse kisi bhi individual ya group ko Pakistan se nikalne ka koi sambandh nahi hai. Isliye, claim ka core assertion ki 'mulle chup kar aur nikal pakistan' ko evidence support nahi karta, balki yeh ek health measure hai.
